🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 30s, with freckles has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Roberto breathes "So it bleeds." the man in his 40s mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

A man, maybe 30s, with freckles leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a dog-shaped silence at the treeline. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks.
